sources.title: See each claim; this file's claims carry their own sources.

note: Claims for polities the boundary source does not name in any year, so there is nothing to carry from a neighbouring snapshot and an extent has to be stated.

claims.note: Athens and the Attic peninsula. The source draws Greek city-states, a fair collective label that the capital test already counts as correct, but the atlas holds Athens as a polity in its own right and could not show it at all. What is drawn is the city's own country: the fifth-century empire was a maritime league, not territory.
